title: Frozen evaluable-only corpus baseline
description:
As an evaluation owner, I want a frozen, citable baseline of per-layer scores on **evaluable (read) cases only**, so that later scanner changes are compared to one snapshot instead of mixed unread and alias noise.

## Current gap

`pnpm run benchmark:run` can print per-layer recall/precision/unread, but:

- It is opt-in, not CI. CI does not materialize 29 upstream clones.
- Nobody has published the post-harness-fix numbers on scanner `develop` as the official baseline (the last full run was against the CLI copy, with the old mixed-bag runner).
- Packets with high unread (PHP/Ruby/Swift/Rust evidence) will dominate any “overall recall” that is not sliced.
- Plexus accuracy/recall was not a successful baseline (proxy `trusted_open` / missing `evaluate_recall`).
- Fixture Jest is already green and too small to steer corpus work.

Without a baseline, every agent will re-run a slightly different command (`--include-proposed`, different materialized cache, CLI vs scanner) and argue from incomparable tables.

## Questions to answer

- Official command, repo, branch, gold review_state (`accepted` only), and whether AI inference is off (must be off for deterministic headline).
- Required columns: packet, layer, evaluable positives, recall, label accuracy, precision, unread count, unread rate. Overall = sum of denominators, not average of percents.
- Do we publish a committed artifact (JSON/Markdown under `tests/benchmark/` or Kanbus wiki) and update it only on gold or scorer contract changes — never on detector tweaks?
- Language slice: a second table restricted to extensions ingest actually reads, so unread-heavy packets do not hide Python/TS/Go signal?
- How do `documentedGap` cases appear (in recall, excluded from CI gates, listed)?
- Materialize in CI or only locally? If locally, how do we authenticate “this baseline was produced from these SHAs”?

## Depends on

Tasks 1–5 should land as *decisions* first, or the baseline will be thrown out when unread/identity/layers change. This task can still specify the *shape* of the report in parallel.

## Not this task

Do not start a scanner improvement loop from an unpublished CLI run. Do not cite Plexus until it uses `scoreEvalCases` (or an agreed identical contract).
